activity_summary: At the printing-house door, in a thin snow, James put a carpenter's rule out from under his cloak and swore the secret on a hot gill. The Upper Frater can be had outright for six hundred pounds, come the spring, when the money is found. You said it was a great deal of money. He said it was a great deal of roof. Dick did not speak. You looked at the lancets and did not talk of the neighbours. You promised the sum would not reach Field or a tiring-house. Nothing was bought, and no timber was to be pulled.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the oath, named the sum once, and refused the book.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Showed the rule, named six hundred and the roof, and cursed Allen in the same breath as the winter.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Did not speak. He looked as if he had heard it every night for a month.

entities.name: the Upper Frater
entities.context: Mentioned in A great deal of roof

facets.activity: Heard six hundred pounds for the Upper Frater

quotes.speaker: james_burbage
quotes.text: Six hundred pounds, come the spring, when the money's found.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It is a great deal of money.

quotes.speaker: james_burbage
quotes.text: It's a great deal of roof.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Six fingers, then, and not shillings.
